name: genesis-review-gate

exports.createReviewGate: Create a configured gate exposing review(input, adapter).
exports.reviewArtifact: Run find/refute through one shared deadline and strict schemas.
exports.validateRefutation: Require status refuted and a non-empty reason.
exports.validateReviewResult: Validate the entire public review result schema.
exports.DEFAULTS: Default input, output, finding and deadline limits.
exports.HARD_LIMITS: Absolute safety bounds for caller-supplied limits.

adapter.refute: async ({artifact, artifactId, finding, deadlineAt, signal}) => {status:'refuted', reason}

integration: Inject a provider adapter; this package never starts a service or calls a model.
